statement: Irreversible redaction/modification requires preserving original separately if provenance matters.
actakit_implication: Public/redacted representation must not overwrite custody artifact.

statement: Public publishing and internal custody have different safety requirements.
actakit_implication: Publication/redaction remains Output/Export policy, not mutation of original evidence.

statement: OCR, page text and redaction can alter or replace derived/public representations while the original needs separate custody if provenance matters.
actakit_implication: Treat OCR/redacted/public copies as Representations or Outputs, never silent replacement of the acquired Artifact.

statement: High-volume document work benefits from bulk processing/tagging/review surfaces, while source-context notes can remain page/region-specific.
actakit_implication: Design operator actions as bulk-capable from the start, but preserve per-claim/per-relation evidence location.

statement: Redaction is destructive to the processed copy and strips metadata; retaining the original is explicitly recommended.
actakit_implication: Redaction/publication creates a derivative Representation/Output and never mutates the custody Artifact.
